_comment: Currency-pair -> Oracle GL Daily Rates ConversionRateType lookup, built from Zensar_GL_Daily_Rates_Extract__3_.txt (234,260 historical rate rows, 2012-01-04 to 2026-06-11). fx_service.py currently hardcodes ConversionRateType=Corporate on every Oracle GL query -- that is now WRONG for almost all pairs.
_finding: 'Corporate' accounts for only 24 of 234,260 rows and was last used 2023-06-05 -- it is a retired/legacy rate type. 'MRC Daily' (raw Oracle type code 300000007815001) is the active daily rate type, used in 221,542 rows (94.6% of the file) up through 2026-06-11 (the most recent date present). 'Period Average' and 'Period End' are month-end close rates, not daily transaction rates, and should not be used for receipt-time FX conversion. 184 of 214 currency pairs have all of MRC Daily/Period Average/Period End on record; none have Corporate as their only type. Recommendation: query ConversionRateType='MRC Daily' (code 300000007815001) by default for all pairs, not 'Corporate'.
